description: We are Green Farm, a multidisciplinary team based in Béni Mellal, Morocco, combining expertise in geoinformatics, hydrology, environmental science, agriculture, programming. Through our project Field Shift, we use NASA Earth observation data to help farmers optimize irrigation, monitor crop health, assess soil conditions, and manage water resources efficiently. Our mission is to sustainable agriculture and support farmers in adapting to climate change and water scarcity.
summary:
GREEN FARM — Project Summary
GREEN FARM is an intelligent agricultural platform designed to help farmers choose the most suitable crops according to available water resources, soil conditions, and climate.

The project addresses a major agricultural challenge: water scarcity and the difficulty of making informed planting decisions. By combining satellite observations, climate information, and agricultural data, GREEN FARM transforms complex environmental information into practical recommendations.

The platform integrates NASA datasets, including GPM IMERG for rainfall monitoring, SMAP for soil moisture information, and NASA POWER for climate variables such as temperature and solar radiation.

Farmers can register their farms, define their locations and areas, provide soil and irrigation information, and analyze their water availability. GREEN FARM then estimates crop water requirements and compares them with available resources to identify suitable crops.

Its main features include farm management, interactive mapping, water analysis, crop selection, crop comparison, and personalized recommendations.

Our mission is to promote sustainable agriculture, improve water-use efficiency, and support farmers in making smarter decisions.
 
GREEN FARM: Grow Smarter. Save Water. Secure the Future.
details:
GREEN FARM — Project Details

GREEN FARM is an intelligent agricultural decision-support platform that helps farmers select suitable crops according to available water resources, soil conditions, and climate.

The platform allows farmers to register their farms, define their geographical location and cultivated area, and provide information about soil type and irrigation resources. It uses NASA Earth observation datasets, including GPM IMERG for rainfall monitoring, SMAP for soil moisture information, and NASA POWER for climate data. By combining these datasets with crop water requirement calculations, GREEN FARM compares estimated water availability with crop needs and provides recommendations to support better planting decisions.

The project aims to promote sustainable agriculture, improve water-use efficiency, reduce water waste, and support farmers, particularly in water-scarce regions.

Its innovative approach transforms complex satellite and environmental data into practical, understandable agricultural recommendations. Instead of relying only on traditional planting practices, GREEN FARM considers the specific environmental and water conditions of each farm.

During development, we considered rainfall variability, irrigation availability, soil characteristics, crop water requirements, climate conditions, geographical location, and satellite data limitations.

The platform also includes farm management, interactive mapping, water analysis, crop comparison, and multilingual accessibility in French, Arabic, and English.

Our vision is to make Earth observation technology accessible to farmers and contribute to more resilient, efficient, and sustainable agriculture.
